# Saw Win Phay — Full Portfolio & Systems Reference

> Personal portfolio website of Saw Win Phay (`https://winphay.celestrionx.com`).
> Engineering focus: Deterministic sandboxes, autonomous agent infrastructure, headless DSP compilers, and interactive WebGL graphics under [CelestrionX](https://www.celestrionx.com).

## 1. Profile & Focus

Saw Win Phay (`WinPhay`) designs systems that prioritize determinism, inspectability, and agent-native verification:

1. **Agent Runtimes & Sandboxing**: Containerized command execution, filesystem checkpoint/rollback, secret redaction, and git worktree isolation (`Vessel`).
2. **Audio & Acoustic Telemetry**: Declarative pure-Rust synthesis graphs compiled headlessly with structured DSP telemetry (`Auralis`).
3. **Interactive Graphics & Digital Publishing**: Procedural Three.js scenes with zero external `.glb` assets (`winphay.celestrionx.com`) and curated bilingual digital publishing (`stellarpub.celestrionx.com`).

---

## 2. Featured Systems

### Vessel (`v0.6.0`)
- **Repository**: `https://github.com/WinPhay/vessel`
- **Role**: Host-shielded, time-traveling container sandbox for autonomous coding agents.
- **Core Capabilities**: `/workspace`-only mounts, cgroup CPU/RAM quotas, `--network none` isolation, instant checkpoints & Myers delta diffs (`vessel_checkpoint`, `vessel_rollback`, `vessel_checkpoint_diff`), isolated git worktree workflows, headless Chromium inspection, and DLP egress redaction.

### Auralis (`v0.2.1`)
- **Repository**: `https://github.com/Celestrionx/auralis`
- **Audio Showcases**: `https://www.celestrionx.com/#demos`
- **Role**: Headless Rust audio graph compiler and closed-loop telemetry engine (`cargo run -- serve`).
- **Core Capabilities**: Declarative JSON/YAML `Song` manifests, `Synth` / `SoundFont` / `Sample` backends, multi-threaded track DSP, WAV (`smpl` loop chunks) & OGG Vorbis exports, and 32-window Hann FFT spectral telemetry (`auralis_init_manifest`, `auralis_compile_audio`, `auralis_inspect_soundfont`, `auralis_eval_wav`).

### StellarPub (`Live`)
- **Domain**: `https://stellarpub.celestrionx.com`
- **Role**: Burmese digital literature catalog and OTA Godot 4 `.pck` distribution pipeline.

---

## 3. Site Architecture (`winphay.celestrionx.com`)

- **Interactive 3D Scene**: Procedural Three.js `r170` scene (`scene.js`) facing South (`E ← S → W`), driven by live local time (`new Date()`) or deterministic URL parameters (`?time=dawn|noon|dusk|night`, `?hour=22.5`).
  - Daytime: Rising East sunrise, drifting 3D cloud clusters, ocean glare, smooth horizon sky shader.
  - Nighttime: Twinkling starfield, orbital Moon reflection path, shoreline campfire particle embers and sand light.
- **Dual Human / Agent Interface**: Toggle between `Wide`, `Side`, `Agent`, and `Hide UI` views directly in the HUD (or open `?mode=agent` / `?ui=agent` to inspect raw machine-readable docs inside the browser).

---

## 4. Mini-Blog Index (`/posts/`)

Metadata index: `https://winphay.celestrionx.com/posts/index.json`

1. **Zero-Asset Procedural South Beach in Three.js** (`Graphics`, `2026-11-26`, 3 min)
   - Raw Markdown: `https://winphay.celestrionx.com/posts/procedural-south-beach-threejs.md`
   - Summary: Syncing a south-facing shoreline, East-to-West solar/lunar arcs, drifting clouds, stars, and a flickering night campfire strictly to local browser time—with zero `.glb` files.
2. **Why Audio Agents Need Compilers and FFT Telemetry** (`AI`, `2026-11-26`, 4 min)
   - Raw Markdown: `https://winphay.celestrionx.com/posts/auralis-audio-telemetry.md`
   - Summary: Treating music as deterministic Rust code: static pre-render linting, parallel DSP, and closed-loop acoustic feedback in Auralis.
3. **Time-Traveling Sandboxes for Coding Agents** (`Systems`, `2026-11-20`, 3 min)
   - Raw Markdown: `https://winphay.celestrionx.com/posts/vessel-agent-sandboxes.md`
   - Summary: How Vessel isolates autonomous agent execution with sub-second filesystem checkpoints, DLP secret redaction, and git worktrees.
